technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot's auto-configuration and profile mechanism to wire in the correct Admin SPI implementation based on active profiles (e.g., 'receptor', 'cloudcontroller').
Implement the Admin SPI as a Java interface with methods: getStatus(ModuleDescriptor), listModules(), and a method returning Map<ModuleDescriptor.Key, ModuleStatus>.
Create a common 'admin-spi' module to hold the SPI interfaces and shared types (ModuleDescriptor, ModuleStatus).
Implement two separate modules: 'receptor-admin' and 'cloudcontroller-admin' each providing a concrete implementation of the Admin SPI.
For Eureka integration, use Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka client to register modules and store metadata as key-value pairs in Eureka's instance metadata.
Extend the Eureka discovery client to support searching by a custom module name in addition to spring.application.name.
The new module registry abstraction will be a Spring bean that manages a collection of module descriptors and delegates to the appropriate Admin SPI implementation.
All implementations will be tested using JUnit 5 and Mockito, with integration tests using embedded servers (e.g., embedded Eureka server, mock Cloud Foundry API).
assumptions: The project already has a build system (e.g., Maven/Gradle) and follows standard Spring Boot project structure.
The team has access to a Cloud Foundry environment for integration tests of the CloudController SPI (or can mock the API).
The Eureka server is assumed to be available and configured externally; no need to implement a Eureka server.
The existing codebase already has a ModuleDescriptor and ModuleStatus classes, or we will define them as part of this work.
User U3 requests a 'permanent location' for SPI implementations; we assume this means creating a dedicated Maven module or package within the existing repository.
Profile-aware wiring (U5) will be implemented using Spring @Profile annotations and conditional beans.
The effort estimates assume a single developer working full-time on this increment with no interruptions.
All user stories must be completed for this increment; no prioritization or deferrals.

activities.activity_description: Review all user stories, clarify acceptance criteria, define the overall architecture, and document the design decisions.

activities.activity_name: Define Admin SPI Interfaces and Shared Types
activities.activity_description: Create the 'admin-spi' common module with interfaces and data classes (ModuleDescriptor, ModuleStatus, Key) used by all implementations.
Implement the Receptor-based Admin SPI providing getStatus, listModules, and map query methods. Includes unit tests.
Implement the CloudController-based Admin SPI with the same interface. Includes unit tests and mock API setup.
Design and implement a new module registry abstraction bean that manages modules and delegates to the active Admin SPI implementation.

activities.activity_name: Relocate SPI Implementations to Common Repository
activities.activity_description: Move the SPI implementation classes into the common module (or create a new module as per U3) and update package structure and imports.
Add Spring @Profile annotations to Admin SPI beans and create auto-configuration classes so that the correct implementation is wired based on active profile (java -jar admin, cf push, etc.).
Add logic to modules to self-register with Eureka upon startup, including metadata for module type and status.
Extend the Eureka discovery client to allow querying modules by a custom name (not just spring.application.name). Includes relevant API and tests.
Implement storage of module metadata (e.g., current state) as Eureka instance metadata, and provide a repository to retrieve it.
Write end-to-end integration tests for all SPI implementations, Eureka interactions, and profile switching. Set up test infrastructure (embedded servers, mocks).
Write documentation for the new SPI, its implementations, profile usage, Eureka integration, and module registry. Update existing user guides.
Perform code review, address feedback, integrate all changes into the main branch, and run full regression tests.
